name: Vietnam Hosting — Kali Linux Minimal (NAT Linux Container)
description: Unprivileged Kali Linux Minimal NAT Linux container compatible with Pterodactyl Console, Wings SFTP, user-space SSH (pubkey-only), persistent storage, and container-safe task scheduling. Not a KVM VPS (no root/systemd/privileged mode). Minimal authorized security-testing container only. Raw packet capture / kernel modules are blocked by standard Wings isolation.

privileged_requirements.notes: Runs completely unprivileged inside standard Pterodactyl Wings isolation.
